item.content: {"url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=quantum+information+scrambling+accessible+records+redundancy+decoherence+experiments&format=json&resultType=core&pageSize=4", "scope": "Europe PMC search metadata, abstracts and full-text links; discovery only", "excerpt": "[{\"title\": \"Finite-Capacity Thermodynamics of Causal Horizons.\", \"abstract\": \"This work proposes that fundamental physics remains unchanged, but its local classical representability is limited by the finite entropic capacity of causal horizons. Geometric entanglement entropy is treated as a thermodynamic potential, and horizons as finite-capacity information systems. When this capacity is saturated, local semiclassical descriptions break down without affecting underlying unitary dynamics. This defines a representational, not dynamical, transition, where configurations persist but cannot be locally encoded. This work formalizes this limit of representation as an intrinsic entropic bound.\", \"doi\": \"10.3390/e28050557\", \"pmid\": \"42187972\", \"pmcid\": \"PMC13206021\", \"source\": \"MED\", \"fullTextUrlList\": {\"fullTextUrl\": [{\"availability\": \"Subscription required\", \"availabilityCode\": \"S\", \"documentStyle\": \"doi\", \"site\": \"DOI\", \"url\": \"https://doi.org/10.3390/e28050557\"}, {\"availability\": \"Open access\", \"availabilityCode\": \"OA\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13206021\"}, {\"availability\": \"Open access\", \"availabilityCode\": \"OA\", \"documentStyle\": \"pdf\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13206021?pdf=render\"}]}}, {\"title\": \"Quantum Theory of the Classical: Einselection, Envariance, Quantum Darwinism and Extantons.\", \"abstract\": \"Core quantum postulates including the superposition principle and the unitarity of evolutions are natural and strikingly simple. I show that-when supplemented with a limited version of predictability (captured in the textbook accounts by the repeatability postulate)-these core postulates can account for all the symptoms of classicality. In particular, both objective classical reality and elusive information about reality arise, via quantum Darwinism, from the quantum substrate.
